# esctest2 tests that fail against this terminal (see esctest_test.dart).
#
# esctest_test.dart fails on any failure not listed here and on any listed
# test that passes, so this list only shrinks. One test per line; '#' starts
# a comment. Each group says what is missing or deliberately left out.
#
# The harness runs the terminal without the app layer.

# Not implemented: HPA (CSI Ps `), HPR (CSI Ps a) and VPR (CSI Ps e).

# Not implemented: DECALN (ESC # 8).
